title: Lucas and His Pocket Money
text:
Lucas gets pocket money from his parents every Saturday. He receives five euros each week. He likes to save part of his money in a small box. Last month he saved twenty euros for a new football.

Sometimes Lucas spends his money on sweets after school. His sister Ana uses her money to buy books. Ana says that saving is important for the future. Lucas and Ana often talk about how to spend their money wisely.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Lucas get each week?
What does Ana use her money to buy?
Why does Lucas save money in a small box?
options: He wants to buy something special later
He does not like his parents
He has no money to spend
He wants to give it to his sister

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Ana?
options: She thinks it is good to plan for the future
She spends all her money on sweets

vocabulary.definition: to keep money for later instead of spending it
small pieces of food with a lot of sugar, like candy
the time that will come after now
in a smart and careful way

paragraph_translations: Lucas recibe dinero de bolsillo de sus padres cada sábado. Recibe cinco euros cada semana. Le gusta ahorrar una parte de su dinero en una caja pequeña. El mes pasado ahorró veinte euros para un balón de fútbol nuevo.

A veces Lucas gasta su dinero en dulces después de la escuela. Su hermana Ana usa su dinero para comprar libros. Ana dice que ahorrar es importante para el futuro. Lucas y Ana hablan a menudo sobre cómo gastar su dinero sabiamente.
